name: Fake Frame Counter
description: Displays clean in-world frame-window circles (1F-12F+), pitched ding sounds, a top-right counter, and Mega Hack macro playback. Uses simulated visual estimates by default.

mode-disclosure-info.description: <cy>Disclosure:</c> In <cg>Fake / Visual Estimate</c> mode (the primary mode), frame-window numbers (<cr>1F</c>-<cb>12F+</c>) are <co>simulated estimates</c> generated from obstacle proximity, movement dynamics, and configurable rules for visual fun—not verified frame-perfect physics calculations. Gameplay overlays omit disclaimer text to stay clean.

enabled.name: Enable Mod
enabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable Fake Frame Counter during gameplay and macro playback.

analysis-mode.name: Window Calculation Mode
analysis-mode.description: Better Estimate (Default): checks if the player is close to a hazard or lethal wall that would kill the player on impact, then picks a random enabled frame window. Fake / Visual Estimate: salience-weighted simulated estimate. Real Analysis (Experimental): macro scan from 0%.

open-menu-keybind.name: Open FFC Menu Popup
open-menu-keybind.description: Keybind to open the Fake Frame Counter control, category, sound guide, and macro menu while in a level.

toggle-overlay-keybind.name: Toggle Overlay Visibility
toggle-overlay-keybind.description: Quickly show or hide the in-world circles and top-right counter while playing.

sensitivity-preset.name: Detection Sensitivity
sensitivity-preset.description: Selective: only close-hazard, orb/portal, or sharp maneuver moments. Balanced: filters out open-space fluff while preserving rapid sequences. Permissive: labels almost all distinct non-duplicate inputs.

sensitivity-bias.name: Sensitivity Fine Tuning
sensitivity-bias.description: Fine-tune moment selection (0.0 = most selective, 0.5 = default, 1.0 = most permissive).

release-filter.name: Release Detection
release-filter.description: Smart: only labels releases in modes where releasing changes flight/dash trajectory (Wave, Ship, active Dash orb). Keeps only the ground circle when jumping over spikes.

max-moments-per-second.name: Max Moment Density (per sec)
max-moments-per-second.description: Maximum labeled moments per second over a sliding 1s window. Preserves short rapid bursts while preventing screen clutter during sustained spam.

min-distance-units.name: Min Circle Spacing (Units)
min-distance-units.description: Minimum world-space distance between consecutive circles (30 units = 1 block). Prevents overlapping circles at the same spot.

proximity-scale-units.name: Hazard Proximity Range (Units)
proximity-scale-units.description: Distance scale (in level units; 30 = 1 block) used to evaluate nearby hazards and solids.

show-circles.name: Show In-World Circles
show-circles.description: Show colored circles and frame-window labels (e.g. 1F, 4F, 12F) at the gameplay location.

circle-scale.name: Circle & Label Size
circle-scale.description: Scale multiplier for the in-world circles and their frame labels.

show-counter.name: Show Top-Right Counter
show-counter.description: Display the compact total and per-category frame-window counter in the top-right corner.

counter-scale.name: Counter Scale
counter-scale.description: Scale multiplier for the top-right counter.

counter-hide-zero.name: Hide Zero-Count Categories
counter-hide-zero.description: Only show enabled categories in the top-right counter once their count is at least 1.

color-tier-1-4.name: 1F-4F Color (Default Red)
color-tier-1-4.description: Color for 1F through 4F circles, labels, and counter rows.

color-tier-5-6.name: 5F-6F Color (Default Orange)
color-tier-5-6.description: Color for 5F through 6F circles, labels, and counter rows.

color-tier-7-9.name: 7F-9F Color (Default Yellow)
color-tier-7-9.description: Color for 7F through 9F circles, labels, and counter rows.

color-tier-10-12.name: 10F-12F+ Color (Default Blue)
color-tier-10-12.description: Color for 10F through 12F (and custom >12F) circles, labels, and counter rows.

sound-enabled.name: Enable Ding Sounds
sound-enabled.description: Play a pitched ding sound whenever a frame-window circle appears.

ding-volume.name: Ding Volume (%)
ding-volume.description: Custom volume percentage for category ding sounds and the Sound Preview Guide (0% to 1000%, e.g. 100, 500, 1000).

pitch-direction.name: Category Pitch Order
pitch-direction.description: Default: 12F has the highest pitch and steps down progressively to 1F (lowest pitch).

custom-global-sound.name: Optional Global Custom Ding Sound
custom-global-sound.description: Optional custom .wav/.ogg/.mp3 sound file used as the base ding (modulated by each category's pitch unless overridden per category in the FFC menu).

macro-lock-delta.name: Lock Physics Step to Macro TPS
macro-lock-delta.description: While playing back a macro, lock GJBaseGameLayer::getModifiedDelta to 1 / macro TPS for deterministic tick timing.

macro-auto-replay.name: Auto-Restart Playback on Reset
macro-auto-replay.description: Automatically restart macro playback from tick 0 when the level resets while playback is active.

macro-frame-offset.name: Macro Frame Offset
macro-frame-offset.description: Tick offset applied to macro inputs during playback (-10 to +10). Adjust if a bot recorded frame 1 as tick 0.
